title: Evergreen inventory report v1
description: The lifecycle result for every object named in exported cloud or cluster state. Evergreen reads only the files given; it never calls the provider's API.

importer.description: The importer that recognized the export.

file.description: The export file as given on the command line.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the version value; for a text export, line:<n>.

resource.description: The resource's own name. Never an account id, ARN, endpoint, or secret.

purl.description: Version-less Package URL the lifecycle rules are written against.

unrecognized.description: Files no importer recognized, as given.
